baseline_construction_method.value: A company-specific internal-performance baseline is proposed, using regression on measured electric-consumption data and monitoring with control charts and CUSUM.
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: Each company can also develop a baseline for internal performance benchmarking, monitor them through the use of control charts and improve them. The regression method using measured data can help firms to analyze their electric consumption and thanks to control charts and CUSUM they can have a real-time monitoring system.

validation_types.evidence_quote: Doing a linear regression with the data relative to the measured quantities has allowed to analyze the P-Value and the significance (right side). From the results, if all the available data are considered, the P-Value is under 0.05 for all the linear regression inclines.

scale_of_application.evidence_quote: The present study aims to define a measurement procedure that will ensure the availability of the necessary data for proper benchmarking of energy performance in production and use of compressed air.
